single.reason: Single-event page renders in the same responsive grid as the populated state; the load-bearing boundary here is empty vs populated, both covered.

many.reason: Events grid wraps responsively with no truncation or pagination; more events only add rows, not a distinct visual state.

loading.reason: Fully static (statically-exported) page with content collections resolved at build; no async/loading state.

edge.reason: Optional-field branches (an event with no link) are exercised within the typical scenario; no distinct edge layout.

error.reason: Static content page with no data fetching; no failure/error state can occur.

key-interaction.reason: Primary actions are outbound links (Subscribe, Volunteer, View Events, mailto); no in-page interactive state to capture.

single.reason: Dashboard always shows all five collection cards; a single entry only changes a count, not the view structure.

many.reason: Fixed five-card grid; large counts render as a larger number, never overflow or truncate.

loading.reason: Static build-time page; counts are read from content collections at render, no async loading state.

edge.reason: Counts are numeric and the summary singular/plural/empty grammar is covered by the empty and populated scenarios plus dashboardSummaryText unit tests.

error.reason: No runtime fetch; content is read at build time, so there is no error state on this view.

key-interaction.reason: The dashboard itself is a launchpad: its actions navigate into a collection or entry route. The in-page interactive state now lives on the entry editor and is captured there by cms-entry-editor-change-staged-for-review.

single.reason: Each chapter route renders exactly one chapter by design; the typical scenario is that single-chapter view

many.reason: A chapter route renders one chapter; the set of chapters lives in the nav dropdown, not this view

loading.reason: Static SSG route rendered at build time; no async loading state

edge.reason: Sparse chapter with no leads/links is demonstrated by the ChapterPage component scenario chapterpage-sparse-no-leads

error.reason: Static SSG route; content collection validated at build, no runtime error state

key-interaction.reason: Presentational page; the only actions are external chapter links (WhatsApp, Eventbrite)

single.reason: The editor renders exactly one entry by definition; there is no empty-to-many boundary on this view.

many.reason: The repeatable leads and links lists stack rows at full width with no overflow, scroll, or truncation treatment, so more rows produce a taller form rather than a distinct layout.

loading.reason: The entry is embedded in the island props at build time; the editor performs no async fetch, so no pending state exists.

error.reason: FOLLOW-UP, not absent: @codeyam/cms 0.2.0 added real in-page failure surfaces to this view — CommitErrorNotice for a failed commit and DriftNotice for a branch that moved under a staged change — so the previous justification that no error surface exists is out of date. Not captured in this repo because both components live in node_modules and are unreachable to editor isolate, and rendering either requires a failing or drifted GitHub commit with no .codeyam/mockable declarations in this project. Capturing it means standing up mock declarations for the CMS GitHub transport, which belongs with the package rather than this consumer.

empty.reason: Empty events list is demonstrated by the EventsPage component scenario eventspage-no-events; not duplicated as a route scenario

single.reason: Single event is a data count, not a distinct layout; the auto-fit card grid is exercised by the typical scenario

many.reason: Auto-fit card grid; the typical four-event scenario already exercises multi-card wrap across upcoming and past

loading.reason: Static SSG route rendered at build time; no async loading state

error.reason: Static SSG route; content collection is validated at build, no runtime error state

key-interaction.reason: Presentational page; the only actions are external links to event registration

single.reason: The homepage composes whole collections; a single event or board member is a data count, not a distinct layout, and the auto-fill grids are exercised by the typical scenario

many.reason: Auto-fill grids; the typical scenario already wraps five board cards and three event cards. More items would not produce a distinct overflow layout

loading.reason: Static SSG route rendered at build time; no async loading state

edge.reason: Board member missing a photo (initials fallback) is demonstrated by the BoardMemberCard initials-fallback component scenario; missing-optional event fields by the EventsPage scenarios

error.reason: Static SSG route; content collections validated at build, no runtime error state

key-interaction.reason: Presentational page; the only actions are external links (Subscribe, WhatsApp, Volunteer, mailto)

many.reason: Real chapters carry 0-2 events; the content has no overflow/truncation state to demonstrate

loading.reason: Statically rendered Astro route from content collections; no async/pending state exists

error.reason: Static prerendered route; an unknown chapter slug is a build-time 404, not an in-page error state

key-interaction.reason: Presentational page; all actions are external-link and mailto navigations with no in-page interactive state
